environment.mode: Isolated Git worktree; ephemeral localhost and native IndexedDB; controlled model fixtures

coverage.interpretation: Browser + actual local archive with fixture model responses. Synthetic provider-only pressure does not constitute a real player session.

ci: See PR checks for the exact published head; a subsequent evidence-only commit has a different commit/tree identity.

externalChecks.productionCorpus: not uploaded or changed by this work; production status not probed
externalChecks.humanLongPlay: not evaluated; checklist in acceptance guide

priorFindings: A stale empty title/restart confirmation was re-bound to the displayed physical archive.
An optional off-scene creditor could crowd out a required turn.
Questions, hearsay, or another actor’s trait could change the wrong combat preview.
An imported child could bypass an already-known marked parent by hash substitution or legacy downgrade; incoming parent death now also reconciles a previously imported portable child.
independentReview.portableBackupBoundary: Native storage checks the available matching local lineage in either import order; a lone portable backup on a new device is not a signed account-level proof.

remoteSourceCI.scope: GitHub check for verified product-source head; later evidence-only commits have their own CI.
